limits: No hosted candidate deployment or matched control. These measurements do not measure the committed optimizations.

Server-Timing spans overlap and nest. Do not sum them to estimate server or network duration.

avoidablePreparationReplyWait.scope: One observed request. This is not a projected median saving. B admission and A/B result validation remain required.
